comment: Profile plugin baseline shared by every machine of this checkout. ensure-profile-plugins.ps1 reconciles each profile against it at launch. A spec starting with link: or file: is resolved against the repository root, so the absolute path is recomputed per machine; any other value is an npm spec and is installed only when the package is absent.
note: 2026-11-19: @local/dsh-mode-3dsmax, @local/dsh-mode-unreal, @local/dsh-web-search-opencode, dsh-remotion and ds-harness-remote were uninstalled from the desktop profile at the owner's request, so they left this baseline too (a baseline entry is what a launch reinstalls). start-desktop.bat no longer calls either Mode install.ps1. The local ones keep their source directories in the tree; reinstall with `dsh plugin --profile desktop add <spec>` when wanted. The web profile keeps both Mode entries because it still mounts them; web-search-opencode is gone from both profiles.
